0022600019.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-1, 2-0 at home, 4th in the East) host the Orlando Magic (1-3, 0-2 at home, 11th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group A game, the Raptors' fifth of the season. Toronto leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 129-99 win in Toronto on October 28, and the Raptors won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain).
